d:
Sthiti ko niyantrit karne ke lie pulis ne lathicharj kiya aur aspatal parisar se bhir ko hataya. is dauran pulis aur aam logon ke bich jamkar jharap huee. ghatna ki suchna milne ke bad patliputr ki sansad misa bharti bhi danapur anumandal aspatal pahunchin. unhonne mritkon ke parijnon se mulakat kar unki bat suni. enkauntar ke bad aspatal parisar men tanavpurn sthiti bani rahi.
